description: Add guests for dinner on a date, or over several days with endDate. Name the household's usual guests in guestNames instead of counting them.

adultCount.description: Number of anonymous adult guests (not counting named ones).

babyCount.description: Number of baby guests (under about two years): they eat from a parent's plate, but the dinner must be safe for them.

childCount.description: Number of anonymous child guests (not counting named ones).

date.description: The dinner date (first day for a multi-day visit), ISO date.

endDate.description: Last day of a multi-day visit, ISO date; omit for a single dinner.

items.description: A usual guest's name as listed among the household's members.

name: add_guests_for_date
title: Add dinner guests
